data.description: Data gathered from the document, in any shape the plugin likes.

dependencies.description:
Files the result depends on besides the request, such as included
files: absolute paths, or paths relative to the site directory
(`site.root`), with `/` separators. A cached result is only reused
while they are unchanged (a file that did not exist must still not
exist), and `lsdocs serve` rebuilds when they change. List files
looked for but missing too.

Diagnostic.description: A problem to report to the user, modeled on LSP diagnostics.

code.description: A short identifier for the kind of problem, e.g. `"broken-link"`.

source.description: Source file the problem is in, relative to the source directory.

oneOf.description: Probably a mistake, but the build continues.

Span.description:
A byte range within the document's source text.

Offsets count UTF-8 bytes from the start of the source, and `end` is
exclusive. The source file is the enclosing [`Document::source`].

end.description: Offset one past the last byte.
